claim_scores.rationale: Defines a blocking `sleeper` using `time.sleep`, wraps it with `dspy.asyncify`, and invokes the asyncified callable in the workload.
Uses `asyncio.gather(*[async_sleeper(delay) for _ in range(tasks)])` to fan out concurrent calls.
Runs the gathered batch inside `dspy.context(async_max_workers=workers)` and tests two settings: 1 and 4 workers.
Measures elapsed time around the awaited batch and asserts the 4-worker run is materially faster than the 1-worker run.
Imports `get_limiter`, checks singleton reuse, and verifies `total_tokens` changes with `async_max_workers`, tying timing to the active limiter.
